# Emran Arifi (عمران عارفی)

> Emran Arifi is a communication student at Kabul University, Afghanistan. He works with Python, cybersecurity, graphic design and web development, and focuses on how AI can transform journalism.

## Facts
- Name: Emran Arifi (also written عمران عارفی / عمران عارفي)
- University: Kabul University, Afghanistan
- Field: Communication and journalism
- Skills: Python, cybersecurity, graphic design (Adobe Photoshop, CorelDRAW), HTML/CSS/JavaScript
- Current projects: a Python tool for analyzing security vulnerabilities in media websites; research on communication technologies and media literacy in conflict zones; a personal visual identity and design portfolio
